scope: Existing production migration only. Interpreter and C API-removal milestones stay closed.
previous_goal_turn: No progress: scope acknowledgement only. This continuation reread the explicit integration objective, polled the live regression handle to terminal status, and fixed the observed adapter failures.
changes: Added compiler-owned tracked player, Judgment, Combo, SongForeground and optional screen-layer output in native order, using the published native child registry and the actual existing lazy constructors.

Tracked identities are retained by a VM-owned pinned batch before authored reads. Copied rows validate VM identity and root generation. Explicit release invalidates identity access while owned captured state survives retirement and VM destruction.

Manual Draw stores raw semantic state only for visible non-player actors inside draw callbacks. Wrapper membership retains identities, other mutable tables are cloned, and property getters run at the native draw/read boundary rather than during raw copying.

Preparation drawing resolves uninitialized Sprite Texture/AFT getters in native order. Inferred Sprite binding is omitted from the semantic snapshot; explicit Load/SetTexture publications retain their native state flag and avoid repeated getters.

Only legacy production change is crate-private visibility on the default child factory so the feature-gated test oracle can exercise the real collector. Native source is otherwise byte-identical; core, manifests and production backend selection are unchanged.
root_contract: The compiler/session must call release_song_tracked_actors on every completion/error path while it owns a batch. Dropping the VM releases all its roots. The batch is not an automatic RAII unpin wrapper.

A fresh transient foreground rooted across a reentrant player-global getter that triggers collection.
